description: Email (or re-send) the invite for a credit that carries an email address, so the person can claim it with their Vidreno account. The same limits as the app apply: a daily cap per account and no repeat email to the same address for the same film within a day. Returns the invite link too; with link_only it only mints the link (nothing is sent), as the editor's copy-link button does.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

link_only.description: true returns the invite link without sending an email (for the user to pass on themselves); it does not count against the daily email cap.

name: invite_film_credit
title: Send a credit invite
